description: Publish the saved installation report preview under the connected user's public co.build account. Updating an existing report replaces its public text. Requires explicit user approval of the exact preview and public attribution. Pass the draftId returned by prepare_installation_report, its unchanged digest and consentVersion (installation-report-v1), and approved:true only after that approval. OAuth consent and installation completion are not publication approval. Retrying the same draftId does not publish a duplicate. A stale or expired draft requires a new preview and new approval.
name: publish_installation_report
title: Publish the approved installation report
